description: Whether a Museumkaart (Dutch museum card) pays off for the Amsterdam museums you plan to visit: exactly the answer of our Museumkaart calculator, with its own ticket prices for 32 Amsterdam museums. Returns ticket total, card price, supplements and how much you save or lose, with a link to the calculator.

age.description: adult (19 or over, default) or youth (up to 18)

museums.description: Museums you plan to visit, e.g. ["Rijksmuseum", "Van Gogh Museum", "Stedelijk", "Anne Frank Huis"]

visits_per_year.description: How often you visit each: 1, 2 or 3 times a year. Default 1.

name: museumkaart
title: Museumkaart: is it worth it?
